# OpenEvidence MCP

> Unofficial open-source MCP server for OpenEvidence.

Important: this project is not affiliated with OpenEvidence, does not provide medical advice, and does not bypass authentication or access controls. It uses the user's own authenticated browser session.

Availability note: OpenEvidence availability may depend on region, account eligibility, and OpenEvidence policy. Public materials in May 2026 indicate verified U.S. HCP/NPI-centered access and EU/U.K. unavailability. This project does not bypass regional, account, or policy restrictions.

## What It Is
- OpenEvidence MCP connects a user's own authenticated OpenEvidence browser session to MCP-compatible clients.
- It provides local tools for auth checks, history, article retrieval, and research questions.

## Who It Helps
- Users with their own OpenEvidence account
- Clinicians
- Clinical researchers
- Medical AI operators
- Teams using OpenAI Codex, Codex CLI, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, or similar MCP hosts

## Core Capabilities
- Validate OpenEvidence auth (`oe_auth_status`)
- List OpenEvidence history (`oe_history_list`)
- Get full article payload (`oe_article_get`)
- Ask and optionally wait (`oe_ask`)

## Client Status
- Target: OpenAI Codex / Codex CLI / Codex app
- Target: Claude Code
- Target: Claude Desktop / Claude app with MCP support
- Compatible: Cursor, Cline, Continue
- Experimental: VS Code / GitHub Copilot MCP environments, Windsurf, Zed, Replit, Sourcegraph-style hosts, Gemini CLI / Google Antigravity-style hosts
- Maintained examples focus on Codex and Claude-style local MCP configuration.
